newsitem.title: USA: ONEOK completes acquisition of PESC.
newsitem.headline: ONEOK completes acquisition of PESC.

text.p: ONEOK Resources Co, a unit of OKEOK Inc, said Friday it completed the acquisition of PESC Inc, an Oklahoma independent oil and gas producing company, in a $25 million stock and cash transaction.

The acquisition includes 180 wells with proven reserves of 20 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 167,000 barrels of oil and a 42 percent interest in the Sycamore Gas Gathering System in Carter County, Okla.
Privately held PESC was developed over a period of 30 years by Ray Potts and Bob Stephenson.
ONEOK Resources vice president Jim Kneale estimated development drilling expenditures for the acquisition would be $7 million to $8 million through 1998.
ONEOK is engaged in intrastate natural gas distribution and transmission, gas processing, gas marketing and oil and gas production.
